description: Lists the account's servers with id, name, join address, region, size, settings, state and recent disk, memory and lag figures. runtime.loadCause, when present, says why a server keeps lagging with players on: memory (garbage collection), cpu-starved (one core shared with background work; a second core fixes it), run-bound (the world's own work; optimise rather than upsize) or unclassified. For when and how badly it lagged, use getServerMetrics. Use it to find the serverId other tools take, by the name the user knows. A server is online only when statusDetail is server-online; desiredState stopped means asleep. joinAttempts lists players the whitelist turned away (see dismissJoinAttempt).
name: listServers
title: List your Minecraft servers
